title: kith-tui: SSE task drops seen event ids on stream error
description: client.rs spawn_sse: when run_sse returns Err (e.g. wifi drop, 'error decoding response body' in rehearsal2/3), the ids seen on that connection are lost, so the next Last-Event-ID is stale or absent. Since KITH-1ln3.19 the client catches up itself on every connect, so this only costs a redundant server replay (skipped by the RFC 8620 §7.1 equal-state check). The comment 'Keep last_event_id on error' overstates what it does. Fix: return the last id alongside the error.
